components.css: .ds-pairs { font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 380px; } .ds-pair { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; color: var(--cz-text, #1C1917); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-pair + .ds-pair { border-top: 1px solid var(--cz-line, #E7E5E4); } button.ds-pair { cursor: pointer; } button.ds-pair:hover, button.ds-pair:active { background: var(--cz-pressed, rgba(28,25,23,0.08)); } button.ds-pair:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cz-text, #1C1917); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pair-claim { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-pair-claim strong { font-size: 16px; line-height: 22px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-pair-claim small { font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--cz-text-muted, #6A625D); } .ds-unknown strong { color: var(--cz-text-muted, #6A625D); } .ds-pair-proof { max-width: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; text-align: right; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.1px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-pair-proof svg, .ds-pair-proof i { width: 18px; flex: 0 0 18px; color: var(--cz-text-muted, #6A625D); } .ds-ok { color: var(--cz-proof, #1F7A4D); font-weight: 800; } .ds-warn { color: var(--cz-warning, #A15C07); } .ds-none { color: var(--cz-text-muted, #6A625D); }

narrative.overview:
crumbz is a ledger of evidence dressed as a quiet stone page. Every claim the screen makes (a score, a price range, a generator, a payment method) sits beside the count of real visits that back it, and the only colour on the page is the colour of that proof. Everything else is a fine warm-neutral scale: stone paper, near-black ink, hairline 1px rules. The world rejects the category's default kit of star ratings, chips and carousels; trust is shown by arithmetic, not decoration.

Density is calm and list-like. A screen reads top to bottom as a column of facts separated by hairlines, with one tonal panel reserved for the score and a row of fixed 4:5 photo plates so visits compare side by side. Type does the hierarchy with only two weights of Manrope, 800 for what is asserted and counted, 500 for everything that describes it. Numbers are always tabular so proof counts line up in a column.

The same identity ships on Android and iPhone. Structure follows Material 3 and the brand lives in the theming. The OS supplies its own back and share glyphs, and iOS keeps its system guarantees (safe area, edge-swipe back, Reduce Motion, 44pt targets, covered by the 48 target). Light and dark are both first-class and follow the system appearance.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, green, spent only on proof counts, confirmations and the WhatsApp action.
Claim on the left, proof on the right, in tabular figures, on every fact.
Flat surfaces, 1px lines, no shadows, no cards.
Fixed 4:5 photo plates for user photos.

rules.name: The Proof Is the Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Green appears only on proof counts, confirmations and the WhatsApp action. If something is not evidence or that action, it stays stone. That includes active states, links and decoration.

rules.name: The Amber Means Unverified Rule
rules.body: `warning` is not a general alert colour. It marks a claim that only the place itself has made.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: 800 for what is asserted or counted: the name, the score, claims, proof counts. 500 for meta, the rank line and buttons. No third weight.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any text that carries a number (score, prices, distances, counts, rank) uses tabular figures so values align in columns.

rules.name: The Reserved Slot Rule
rules.body: Every proof pair keeps its chevron slot, even when it cannot expand, so the proof column never jitters.

rules.name: The Stack Under Rule
rules.body: Above font scale 1.15 the proof goes under the claim; claims and proof are never truncated to keep them side by side.

rules.name: The Hairline Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: If two regions need separating, use a 1px rule or a tonal step. Never a shadow.

dos: Do attach a proof to every claim about a place, worded by basis (promedio / confirmado / reportado) with the visit count in tabular figures.
Do keep green for proof counts, confirmations and the WhatsApp button only.
Do use amber only for "solo lo dice el lugar".
Do use 800 for the name, the score, claims and proof counts, and 500 for meta, the rank line and buttons.
Do separate list rows with 1px `line` rules and keep surfaces flat.
Do hold user photos on fixed 4:5 plates.
Do reserve the chevron slot on every proof pair and stack proof under the claim above font scale 1.15.
Do keep every touch target at 48px or more and give icon-only buttons an accessibility label.
Do use the OS back and share glyphs (iOS ChevronLeft/Share, Android ArrowLeft/Share2).
donts: Don't add shadows; depth is tonal steps and hairlines.
Don't wrap facts in cards or chips; the score panel is the one tonal panel.
Don't introduce a second accent colour, or use green for active states, links or decoration.
Don't use star ratings or carousels to express quality; show the score with its count and distribution.
Don't add a third font weight or a second family.
Don't crop user photos to ratios other than 4:5.
